questions.answer: Skiing - make sure to be well in advance to get a student pass to Whistler mountain resort.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Very easy. Everyone is very outgoing.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Nothing. Everyone is very friendly and European-like.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Make sure to be well in advance to get the student pass to Whistler. A lot of social activities are centered around skiing.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Make sure to be well in advance to get the student pass to Whistler.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: To be social, meet new people and ski.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: To adapt to their food prices.
